mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, content, tags, weather, mood, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary (id, user_id, title, content, tags, weather, mood, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{tags, typeHandler=com.otoluudiary.handler.JsonStringListTypeHandler}, #{weather}, #{mood}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE diary SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, tags = #{tags, typeHandler=com.otoluudiary.handler.JsonStringListTypeHandler}, weather = #{weather}, mood = #{mood}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.tag FROM diary d, JSON_TABLE(d.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS (tag VARCHAR(100) PATH '$')) t WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND t.tag IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.tag) != '' ORDER BY t.tag
